context: Tests that Step 5 (load/enrich assets) reuses the existing environment: creds come from cloudflare/.secrets and the env id from repo config, so the agent never collects credentials, picks a run tier, boots a backend, or deploys. Guards against dragging the demo into the disabled dedicated/backend path.

checklist.name: Runs enrich-assets.js against existing secrets
checklist.description: The agent invokes scripts/agent/enrich-assets.js (dry-run then live) with the company key, relying on cloudflare/.secrets for creds and repo config for the env id; it does not hand-roll author API calls.

checklist.name: Never collects credentials or asks for a secret/settings screen
checklist.description: The agent does not ask the customer for Content Hub/DM credentials, an AEM env id, or any pasted secret (I2), and does not ask them to open a Settings/permissions screen.

checklist.name: No backend onboarding / boot / deploy
checklist.description: The agent does not run a local-run tier choice, does not gate enrichment on booting a backend, and does not deploy/merge to make assets searchable.

checklist.name: Scopes to the company and verifies the visible outcome
checklist.description: The agent sets DEMO_COMPANY to the company key as a local edit and verifies search returns assets with non-zero facet buckets.

checklist.name: Plain language, no internal terms
checklist.description: No internal terms (tier, deploy, scope, phase names) surfaced to the customer.
